mapper.select: select u.id as id, u.nickname as nickname, u.avatar as avatar, u.hannote_id as hannote_id, coalesce(uc.note_total, 0) as note_total, coalesce(uc.fans_total, 0) as fans_total from t_user u left join t_user_count uc on u.id = uc.user_id where u.status = 0 and u.is_deleted = false and u.id = #{userId}
